# googleads_campaign_criterion (Resource)

Campaign-scoped targeting or exclusion: location, language, device bid modifier, ad schedule, or IP block. Exactly one variant must be set. Status and bid_modifier are mutable; everything else is immutable per the API. v1 covers the five most-used variants — keyword / placement / audience / topic etc. land later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Target the United States.
resource "googleads_campaign_criterion" "us" {
  customer_id = "1234567890"
  campaign_id = googleads_campaign.search.id
  location_id = "geoTargetConstants/2840"
}

# Bid 25% more on mobile.
resource "googleads_campaign_criterion" "mobile_boost" {
  customer_id  = "1234567890"
  campaign_id  = googleads_campaign.search.id
  device_type  = "MOBILE"
  bid_modifier = 1.25
}

# Run weekdays 9am–6pm.
resource "googleads_campaign_criterion" "weekday_business_hours" {
  customer_id              = "1234567890"
  campaign_id              = googleads_campaign.search.id
  ad_schedule_day_of_week  = "MONDAY"
  ad_schedule_start_hour   = 9
  ad_schedule_end_hour     = 18
  ad_schedule_start_minute = "ZERO"
  ad_schedule_end_minute   = "ZERO"
}

# Target a 7km radius around downtown Belo Horizonte.
resource "googleads_campaign_criterion" "bh_centro" {
  customer_id          = "1234567890"
  campaign_id          = googleads_campaign.search.id
  latitude             = -19.911
  longitude            = -43.985
  radius               = 7.0
  radius_units         = "KILOMETERS"
  address_country_code = "BR"
  address_city_name    = "Belo Horizonte"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `campaign_id` (String) Parent campaign resource name. Immutable.
- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID.

### Optional

- `ad_schedule_day_of_week` (String) MONDAY..SUNDAY. Required when configuring an ad schedule.
- `ad_schedule_end_hour` (Number) Schedule end hour (0–24, 24 = end of day). Required when configuring an ad schedule.
- `ad_schedule_end_minute` (String) ZERO, FIFTEEN, THIRTY, or FORTY_FIVE. Required when configuring an ad schedule.
- `ad_schedule_start_hour` (Number) Schedule start hour (0–23). Required when configuring an ad schedule.
- `ad_schedule_start_minute` (String) ZERO, FIFTEEN, THIRTY, or FORTY_FIVE. Required when configuring an ad schedule.
- `address_city_name` (String) Optional city-name label attached to the proximity. Does not affect serving.
- `address_country_code` (String) Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code attached as a label on the proximity (e.g. "BR"). Does not affect serving.
- `bid_modifier` (Number) Bid multiplier in range 0.1–10.0. Use 0 to opt out (Device only). Mutable.
- `device_type` (String) Apply a device-level bid modifier. One of MOBILE, TABLET, DESKTOP, CONNECTED_TV, OTHER.
- `ip_address` (String) Exclude an IP / CIDR.
- `keyword_match_type` (String) EXACT, PHRASE, or BROAD. Required when keyword_text is set.
- `keyword_text` (String) Keyword text. Typically used with `negative = true` to add a campaign-level negative keyword that applies to every ad group. Pair with `keyword_match_type`. Immutable.
- `language_id` (String) Target a language. Value is a languageConstants/{id} resource name, e.g. "languageConstants/1014" (Portuguese).
- `latitude` (Number) Latitude (degrees, WGS84) of the centre of a radius-targeting proximity. Required together with longitude, radius, and radius_units. Stored at micro-degree precision (~0.11 m).
- `location_id` (String) Target a geo location. Value is a geoTargetConstants/{id} resource name, e.g. "geoTargetConstants/2840" (United States).
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude (degrees, WGS84). Required together with latitude.
- `negative` (Boolean) If true, exclude the criterion rather than target it. Immutable.
- `radius` (Number) Proximity radius. Units determined by radius_units (1–800 KM or 1–500 MI).
- `radius_units` (String) KILOMETERS or MILES.
- `status` (String) ENABLED, PAUSED, or REMOVED. Mutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource name (customers/{cid}/campaignCriteria/{campaign_id}~{criterion_id}).
